doctrine_ref: v2 §4 D8 + tombstone pair (case_31 vs case_32); Master Plan §2 pillar D; deletion_rules.csv rule_15
rationale: Rule_15 permits only a stable user_id on a tombstone. A surviving hash is a gate-blocking key form (D8: keeping any key form, including a hash, is INCOMPLETE). Status DELETED must never be trusted over a field dump.
request_summary: Synthetic subject requests full deletion. The account tombstone carries status DELETED but retains the email hash and phone number.
title: Dirty tombstone: hash and phone survive a status-only delete
